payload.name: description
payload.value:
## Trigger

When a customer installs basicly and adds its own fragments, I want the shipped core to stay at or under 150 lines with the most important rules first, so I can keep 50 lines of the 200-line vendor budget for my repository without losing the gates at the tail.

## Confirmation Plan

Install the worktree catalog into an empty scratch repository and count the lines of each always-on file. Run the guidance, planner and loader tests, the new core-budget test, catalog lint and the projection checks. Read the rendered headings to confirm Never do, Ask first, Commands, then Always do in phase order.
